name: Ramps
siboNotes: Ramps are high in fructans and should be avoided during SIBO treatment. Even small amounts can trigger symptoms in sensitive individuals.
preparationTips: Use only the green tops sparingly as flavoring if tolerated
Infuse oil with ramps then remove solids for milder flavor
Start with tiny amounts to test individual tolerance
Avoid the white bulb portion which is highest in FODMAPs
